presets.label: Quadruped · Bench-fit motors · 400 Hz
presets.description: Live WASD trial with the per-motor bench-fit candidates and the shared FPGA integer controller at 400 Hz. W/S request forward/reverse; A/D request gentle arcing turns. Release keys or use Stop to request a controlled stop.
presets.readiness: Experimental fitted motors · 400 Hz motor loop · 200 Hz native measurement profile · 50 Hz motion policy and live observations. Detailed solver measured about 0.05× real time on this Mac. Calibration remains provisional.
presets.evidence: Uses the exact ID 10/11/12 candidate parameters from the measured-voltage motor study, repeated by actuator role across four legs as an explicit assumption. Internal motor/gearbox dynamics, encoder quantization and the FPGA integer law execute in Rust. The 1.25 ms feedback delay is an estimate. Supply is imposed at 11.1 V; loaded accuracy, battery behavior, twelve-motor physical bus timing and whole-robot hardware transfer remain unqualified. Model and cadence overrides are saved with input replay.
